## Validation and caveats

Relative recall was **15/15 (100%)** in the development set and **6/6 (100%)** in the held-out validation set. The held-out set was not used for term mining, but came from the same screened pool, so it is semi-independent rather than external validation.

The required Entrez-date bound excludes records added to PubMed after 2020-05-15; no publication-date limit was applied. The rotator-cuff category probe is marked stale because the intervention block expanded after the last probe and the probe budget was spent. Two samples of 30 found no eligible omissions, but they do not establish complete recall. This is a draft for information-specialist PRESS review; PubMed-only coverage is another limitation.
